query: Please implement a scan-to-order mini-program for customers to browse dishes, place orders, and make payments. The mini-program should have functionalities for displaying dishes, placing orders, and making payments. Users should be able to browse dishes, select the dishes they want to order, submit orders, view order details, and make online payments. The mini-program should also be able to record users' order history and consumption records. Use linen white for container backgrounds and burlywood for component visuals.
